title: IntelligenceClassification
description: Evaluation schema classifying continuous frontier AI developments into Hype, Facts, or Signal.

item_id.description: Unique identifier for the evaluated development or finding.

source.description: Origin URL, repo, paper citation, or practitioner post.

title.description: Concise summary title of the finding.

classification.description: HYPE: Marketing claims without code/proof. FACT: Verified updates/CVEs/specs. SIGNAL: Breakthrough architectures/patterns with measurable local impact.

rationale.description: Detailed engineering rationale justifying the category.

reproducible_evidence.description: Whether reproducible benchmark, source code, or verification proof exists.

target_rag_collection.description: Target AIDB collection if recommended_action is SEED_RAG.
